cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've tightened that tap joint. I taught you the checks; turn it on before I start washing up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remember why we test. Put my apron on and turn it slowly; this is the practical part of your lesson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wear it. It's your repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You won't learn by watching me. Take my raincoat instead; if you can keep it dry, I'll trust the tap with the dishes.

reason: Have A make the pupil practical test a precondition of its own reliance and answer B role reversal by upgrading protection rather than testing itself.
